dimensions.assessment: Affects state, local, tribal governments, first responders, and law enforcement agencies implementing tracking tools.

dimensions.assessment: Provides an additional eligible use for existing grant programs to track overdoses and reversal medication administration.
dimensions.evidence: track the locations of suspected fatal and nonfatal overdoses and the administration of opioid overdose reversal medication

dimensions.assessment: Expands allowable uses of grant funds without stating a new separate authorization of appropriations.
dimensions.evidence: allow grants under the Comprehensive Opioid, Stimulant, and Substance Use Program to be used

dimensions.assessment: Amends the Omnibus Crime Control and Safe Streets Act of 1968 to add a specific grant activity category.
dimensions.evidence: To amend the Omnibus Crime Control and Safe Streets Act of 1968 to enhance the Comprehensive Opioid Abuse Grant Program

dimensions.assessment: Permanent statutory expansion of grant program authorities.

importance_detail.rationale: Expands the Comprehensive Opioid Abuse Grant Program to allow grant funds to be used for implementing overdose data collection programs by state, local, tribal, and law enforcement entities.
